other_conditions: Highly qualified and experienced superannuated teachers of recognized universities/colleges/institutions are eligible
Applicant must not hold any other post or be gainfully employed at the time of joining the fellowship
The fellowship must be joined within three months of the award letter issuance
The awardee can work up to the age of 70 years or for a maximum of two years, whichever is earlier
No extension of the fellowship period is permitted
The fellow must submit a research report and upload the work to the INFLIBNET repository at the end of the tenure
The fellow must submit an Undertaking Certificate signed by the head of the research centre
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly honorarium of Rs 31,000 for two years plus a contingency grant of Rs 50,000 per year for research-related expenses.
documents_required: Joining Report with photograph, address and contact number (Annexure‑II)
